title: The Assistant (Claude)
intro: Ask Claude about your loans and properties, or ask it to do things in the app. It reads your data and the files you give it, and every change it proposes waits on a card for your Approve.

topics.title: Open the assistant
topics.intro: The Assistant button sits at the bottom right of every screen.

steps.title: The Assistant button
steps.text: Click Assistant (bottom right) on any screen. The chat opens over the app; whatever you were doing stays as it was underneath.

marks.label: Assistant
marks.text: Opens the chat with Claude.

steps.title: The chat window
steps.text: A new chat starts with a few example questions. Everything you need is on this one window: what to ask about, the question box, and the buttons on top.

marks.label: Compact
marks.text: Shortens a long chat into a summary that keeps the facts, so Claude stays quick. Your messages stay saved.

marks.label: New chat
marks.text: Starts a fresh conversation. The current one is kept in History; nothing in your loans changes.

marks.label: History
marks.text: Your saved conversations — open, search, rename, pin or delete them.

marks.label: Close
marks.text: Closes the window. The chat stays as it is for next time.

marks.label: Connection
marks.text: Green: Claude is connected and ready. Amber: it isn’t — see “Connection settings” below.

marks.label: Example question
marks.text: Click one to ask it straight away.

marks.label: Property
marks.text: Point the chat at one property (or keep it general). Claude reads that property’s saved files first, and files you attach are saved to it.

marks.label: Model
marks.text: Which Claude model answers. “Automatic” lets your subscription choose; the others are the models it offers.

marks.label: Effort
marks.text: How hard Claude thinks: Low is fastest, Max reasons the deepest (a little slower). High is the default.

marks.label: Attach
marks.text: Adds files to the message — PDF, Word, Excel, text or pictures. They are read on your computer.

marks.label: Message
marks.text: Type your question or what you want done. Enter sends; Shift+Enter starts a new line.

marks.label: Send
marks.text: Sends the message. While Claude works this button turns into Stop.

marks.label: Connection settings
marks.text: How the app connects to Claude: your Claude subscription or an API key.

topics.title: Ask a question
topics.intro: Claude answers from your own loans and properties — the same figures the app shows.

steps.title: Type the question
steps.text: Type in the message box at the bottom, then click Send (or press Enter).

marks.label: Your question
marks.text: Plain words are fine — name a property, a lender or a date.

marks.label: Send
marks.text: Sends it to Claude.

steps.title: The answer
steps.text: Your question shows on the right, Claude’s answer on the left. Ask a follow-up in the same box — the chat remembers what was said.

marks.label: Your message
marks.text: What you asked.

marks.label: Claude’s answer
marks.text: Worked out from the app’s own figures. It never makes up a number — when something is missing it says so.

marks.label: Follow-up
marks.text: Ask the next question here; the conversation carries on.

topics.title: Focus on a property
topics.intro: Pick a property and the chat is about it: Claude reads its saved documents first, and what you attach is saved to it.

steps.title: Pick the property
steps.text: Choose a property in the list under the chat. “No property — general chat” is for the whole portfolio. A chat started on a property is saved with that property.

marks.label: Property
marks.text: The property this chat is about. Opening the assistant from a loan’s page picks that loan’s property for a new chat.

marks.label: Its documents
marks.text: How many of the property’s saved documents Claude can read.

topics.title: Ask it to do something — the Approve card
topics.intro: Claude can add properties, fill in details, edit loans, import files, run a refinance and more — but nothing changes until you approve its card.

steps.title: Attach a document
steps.text: Click the paperclip and pick the file (here a made-up property summary). It shows above the message box; it is read on your computer and sent with your message.

marks.label: Attach
marks.text: Opens your computer’s file window to pick one or more files.

marks.label: Attached
marks.text: The files going with your message, and how much was read from each. The × on a file removes it.

marks.label: Saved files
marks.text: How many files are already saved with this property. When you send, the attached file is saved to it too.

marks.label: What to do
marks.text: Say what you want done with the file.

steps.title: The Approve card
steps.text: Claude proposes the change on a card: each line shows the old value, the new one and where it came from (file, page, quote). Untick a line to leave it out.

marks.label: The card
marks.text: What Claude wants to do, line by line.

marks.label: Tick box
marks.text: Only ticked lines are applied — untick one to leave it out.

marks.label: Old → new
marks.text: The value now (crossed out; “none” when empty) and the value Claude proposes.

marks.label: Where it came from
marks.text: The file, page and quote the value was read from, so you can check it.

marks.label: Approve & apply
marks.text: Makes the change, saved in the field’s history as “Assistant, approved by You”.

marks.label: Cancel
marks.text: Nothing is changed; Claude is told you said no.

marks.label: Stop
marks.text: Claude is waiting for your answer. Stop ends its turn and cancels the card — nothing is changed.

steps.title: Approved — and what happened
steps.text: After Approve the card shows what was done (✓) and Claude reports back. Cards that wait for you are never applied by themselves; Stop cancels a waiting card.

marks.label: Done
marks.text: The card is closed: it says what was applied (✓) and what was left out. Its buttons are greyed — a card is used once.

marks.label: Claude’s report
marks.text: Claude is told exactly what happened and says so.

topics.title: Saved chats (History)
topics.intro: Every conversation is saved on its own, grouped by property — reopen one to carry on.

steps.title: The list
steps.text: History lists every saved chat, grouped by property (the property you’re on first, then the portfolio, then the rest). Hover a chat for its buttons.

marks.label: Search
marks.text: Finds words in every saved chat.

marks.label: This property / All
marks.text: Only this property’s chats, or all of them.

marks.label: Back to chat
marks.text: Returns to the conversation you were in.

marks.label: Group
marks.text: The property (or Portfolio) the chats below belong to.

marks.label: A chat
marks.text: Its title (your first question), how many messages and when. Click it to reopen and carry on.

marks.label: Pin
marks.text: Keeps it at the top.

marks.label: Rename
marks.text: Gives it your own title.

marks.label: Delete
marks.text: Deletes the conversation (it asks first).

steps.title: Reopened
steps.text: A reopened chat shows its messages and its cards as they ended (read only — an old card can’t be approved again). Type to carry on where you left off.

marks.label: An old card
marks.text: What was proposed and what you decided.

marks.label: Carry on
marks.text: Your next message continues this conversation.

topics.title: Compact a long chat
topics.intro: A long conversation gets slower. Compact keeps the facts and frees up room.

steps.title: Compacted
steps.text: Click Compact: Claude writes a short brief of the conversation (every property, figure and decision) and carries on from it. The full messages stay in the saved chat.

marks.label: Compact
marks.text: Summarizes the chat so far.

marks.label: The brief
marks.text: What Claude keeps from here on.

topics.title: Connection settings
topics.intro: How the app reaches Claude: your Claude subscription (recommended) or an Anthropic API key.

steps.title: Connected
steps.text: Click “Connection settings” under the Attach button. The Claude connection window shows how the app connects; signed in to your Claude subscription, nothing else is needed. (The same window opens from Settings → Claude connection.)

marks.label: Status
marks.text: Green: connected, and how. Amber: not connected, and what is missing.

marks.label: Sign out
marks.text: Signs this computer out of your Claude subscription. The assistant stops until you connect again.

marks.label: Advanced — API key
marks.text: Opens the API-key choice, for pay-as-you-go use instead of a subscription.

marks.label: Anthropic API key
marks.text: Paste a key from console.anthropic.com. It is kept only on this computer and never shown again.

marks.label: Save
marks.text: Saves the key and switches the app to use it.

marks.label: Close
marks.text: Closes this window.

steps.title: When Claude isn’t connected
steps.text: If Claude isn’t connected the status turns amber, Send is greyed out and the connection choices open inside the chat by themselves.

marks.label: Not connected
marks.text: What is missing, in plain words.

marks.label: Connect with your Claude subscription
marks.text: Opens a small sign-in window that takes you to your browser. When you finish, the status turns green.

marks.label: Automatic
marks.text: Uses your Claude subscription, and an API key if one is saved (recommended).

marks.label: Claude subscription
marks.text: Only the subscription — no API key, no per-use billing.

marks.label: Anthropic API key
marks.text: Only an API key — pay as you go.

marks.label: API key
marks.text: Paste a key here. It is kept only on this computer and never shown again.

marks.label: Save
marks.text: Saves the key; the status re-checks.

marks.label: Send (greyed)
marks.text: Waits until Claude is connected, so a message is never lost.
